To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
electroweak corrections are important for Higgs production in e+ e- collisions and that they can be calculated reliably.
the full O(alpha)-corrections to e+ e->f f H are of the order +/-10% and that the corrections are dominated by QCD corrections and the interference of the O(alpha) corrections with the Born process.
the full electroweak corrections are large for Higgs production in e+ e- collisions and that they are of similar size as the QCD corrections, which have been calculated previously by other authors.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the calculation of higher-order QED corrections to the Higgs production processes e+ e- -->nu anti-nu H (and the corresponding reaction with t quarks in the initial state) and e+ e-->t anti-t H in the Standard Model.
the calculation of electroweak corrections and their interplay with higher-order QCD corrections to Higgs-boson production in e+ e- annihilation.
the study of the Higgs boson production and decay in the Standard Model and beyond.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the O(alpha) corrections for the process e+ e- --> nu anti-nu gamma* --> nu anti-nunu anti-nu gamma are very large, but that they are almost completely compensated by the QED corrections.
the O(alpha) electroweak corrections for the process e+ e- -->nu anti-nu H at the NLC are of the order +/- 5% and that the O(alpha alpha(s)) corrections are also of the order +/-5%.
electroweak corrections are of similar size to QCD corrections and are important for precision physics at future e+e- colliders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are able to predict the Higgs production cross section in e+ e- collisions with a precision of about 10% at energies of 500 GeV.
the electroweak corrections are of the same order of magnitude as the higher-order corrections from the initial-state radiation, and the full O(alpha)-corrections are of the order +/-10%.
we have calculated all electroweak corrections of O(alpha) for the process e+e- -> nu anti- nu H.
The main takeaway from our work is that
electroweak corrections are important for Higgs-boson production at high energies.
the O(alpha) corrections are large and should not be neglected in the theoretical predictions.
the electroweak corrections are large and should be taken into account for a precise determination of the Higgs mass.
